acceptances.justification: Debian 13 has no fixed expat package yet, and the verified DHI VEX does not mark this finding not affected.
acceptances.impact: Malformed UTF-16 XML may hide markup from Expat and permit XML injection if untrusted XML reaches a parser.
acceptances.exploitability: The production debate service accepts signed Discord JSON and has no XML request endpoint; SDK XML parsing remains a possible indirect path.
acceptances.evidence: Debian tracker https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-93990 and PR 423/424 Grype ARM64 reports show libexpat1 2.8.3-1~deb13u1+dhi3 as not-fixed without a DHI VEX exemption.
acceptances.reevaluation_conditions: Remove this acceptance when Debian or DHI ships a fix, a verified VEX changes status, the image digest changes, or XML exposure changes.
